user.title: Create a heater thermostat
user.description: Select the room temperature sensor and the physical heater switch. The integration will control the heater continuously, so separate ON/OFF automations are not required.

data.name: Name
data.on_temperature: Turn heater ON at or below
data.off_temperature: Turn heater OFF at or above
data.min_gap: Minimum gap between ON and OFF
data.fail_safe: Turn heater off if the temperature sensor is unavailable

error.invalid_range: The maximum temperature must be higher than the minimum temperature.
error.on_out_of_range: The ON temperature must be inside the selectable range.
error.off_out_of_range: The OFF temperature must be inside the selectable range.
error.gap_too_small: The OFF temperature must be above the ON temperature by at least the minimum gap.
error.heater_in_use: This heater switch is already controlled by another Heater Thermostat.

abort.already_configured: This heater switch is already controlled by a Heater Thermostat.
